name: ResortPass
description: Book day access to the world's best hotel pools and spas — no overnight stay required. Discover exclusive pool passes, cabana rentals, massages, spa days, and more across thousands of hotels. Search by location, date, experience, and number of guests. From a relaxing poolside cabana in Miami to a luxurious massage in New York City, your perfect daycation is just a prompt away.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ResortPass to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ResortPass to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.resortpass.com/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ResortPass MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ResortPass provides these MCP tools: search_experiences.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ResortPass?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to ResortPass in e-commerce on the Manufact MCP catalog include Figaro Immobilier, Shop, eYantra Corporate Gifting, Get My eSIM, and Is It Legit by M8ven.
ResortPass requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ResortPass is developed by ResortPass. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
